subject.title: fix: route direct outbound polls through channel adapters

question: Should this PR merge with Telegram live proof plus shared direct/hybrid poll contract tests, or should maintainers require broader live proof from another direct or hybrid poll-capable plugin first?
rationale: The code path is correct by source inspection, but the change affects outbound poll delivery semantics across channel adapters, so maintainers own the acceptable proof breadth before merge.

options.title: Merge with covered delivery risk
options.body: Accept the Mantis Telegram proof and focused regression tests as enough coverage for the shared adapter contract.

options.title: Request broader live proof
options.body: Ask for one more live direct or hybrid poll-capable plugin proof before merge if maintainers want runtime coverage beyond Telegram.

recommendation.title: Merge with covered delivery risk
